title: A Autopsy for the Alibi
author: Freya Nakamura
blurb: Beatrix Hartwell, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, has spent seven years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. But when a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the tide gives up what it took.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
